purpose: Reproducible storage and orchestration behavior checks using curated judgments; not a measured improvement in human learning

cases.prompt: What makes the derivative of f at x a mathematical definition rather than an algebraic shortcut?

options.label: The limit of a difference quotient as its increment tends to zero
Substituting a zero increment directly into the quotient
Expanding the numerator without taking a limit

cases.learner_explanation: The limit is unnecessary because ordinary algebra already gives the instantaneous derivative.
cases.known_misconception: confusing algebraic simplification with the existence of a limit
cases.independent_transfer: Explain when the derivative of |x| at x=0 fails to exist.

cases.prompt: Why is the Euclidean length of a physical vector unchanged by a rotation of its coordinate axes?

options.label: Its Cartesian components remain separately unchanged
Orthogonal rotations preserve the dot product
The vector must point along the rotation axis

cases.learner_explanation: The physical vector and each of its numeric components remain exactly unchanged after rotating coordinates.
cases.known_misconception: confusing vector invariance with invariance of coordinate components
cases.independent_transfer: Derive the dot-product invariance under a two-dimensional rotation matrix.

cases.prompt: In a steady circuit, why do the currents entering a node sum to the currents leaving it?

options.label: Because the voltage across every resistor is identical
Because the power dissipated in each branch is fixed
Because charge does not accumulate at the node

cases.learner_explanation: Some charge is consumed as it passes each resistor, but the node immediately creates more.
cases.known_misconception: treating charge as consumed by resistance
cases.independent_transfer: Analyze an RC transient where charge temporarily accumulates on a capacitor plate.

cases.prompt: Which change is a plausible population-level result of natural selection?

options.label: A favorable inherited allele becomes more frequent over generations
An individual deliberately changes its genome to meet a challenge
Every mutation improves fitness in all environments

cases.learner_explanation: Organisms decide to develop a favorable inherited trait and then transmit it to offspring.
cases.known_misconception: intentional acquisition mistaken for population-level selection
cases.independent_transfer: Predict allele-frequency change when environmental selection pressure reverses.

cases.prompt: What is the best initial method for evaluating two conflicting eyewitness accounts?

options.label: Assume the earlier account must be true
Compare provenance, context, incentives, and independent corroboration
Average the accounts into one factual statement

cases.learner_explanation: If any two accounts mention the same event, they prove every proposed cause of that event.
cases.known_misconception: corroborated observation confused with corroborated causal explanation
cases.independent_transfer: Evaluate two independently authored but politically interested accounts of a treaty.

cases.prompt: After soldering adjacent pins, which procedure best checks for an unintended solder bridge?

options.label: Assume transparent flux residue is an electrical short
Power on immediately to test whether anything overheats
Inspect with magnification and check electrical continuity as appropriate

cases.learner_explanation: Any shiny transparent area on solder mask means a conductive connection has formed.
cases.known_misconception: visual flux residue equated with a conductive bridge
cases.independent_transfer: Distinguish a cold joint, flux residue, and a conductive short using safe inspection.

cases.prompt: Why is binary search on a sorted array logarithmic in the worst case?

options.label: The unresolved search interval is at most halved on each comparison
Every array element is inspected once
A binary tree guarantees constant time for every input

cases.learner_explanation: After k iterations at most n/2^k positions remain, so k is proportional to log2(n).
cases.independent_transfer: Prove the bound when n is not a power of two and the target is absent.

cases.prompt: In the sentence 'The collection of manuscripts is rare', why is 'is' singular?

options.label: 'Manuscripts' is the nearest noun
The head of the subject noun phrase is singular 'collection'
Every noun in the phrase is grammatically singular

cases.learner_explanation: The head noun 'collection' determines the subject's number; the prepositional phrase does not change it.
cases.independent_transfer: Explain agreement in 'The results of the experiment are unexpected'.

cases.prompt: When new evidence arrives, which quantity must account for the likelihood of that evidence?

options.label: The posterior probability
The prior probability alone
The sample mean of unrelated observations

cases.independent_transfer: Explain the base-rate effect in a medical screening example without assuming probabilities.

cases.prompt: Given P implies Q and P, which conclusion is valid?

options.label: Not Q
Q
Not P

cases.learner_explanation: The conjunction of P implies Q and P entails Q by modus ponens.
cases.independent_transfer: Explain why Q and P implies Q do not entail P.
